ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT (this“Agreement"),made as ofJune , 2021, by and between Miriam Prince Trust, by Mainert Prince and Percival J. Prince as co-trustees and Miriam Prince as lifetime beneficiary of said trust,having an address at 1046 President Street, Brooklyn, New York 11225 (the “Owner") and President Lofts 2 LLC, having an address at 100-A Broadway, No. 456, Brooklyn, New York 11249 (collectively, the "Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, the Owner is the owner in fee title of a certain parcel of land in Brooklyn, NY, known as and by the street address 1046 President Street,Brooklyn,New York 11225 designated as Block 1280, Lot 30 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, Kings County, and more particularly described in Exhibit A-1 annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land and tax lot being hereinafter referred to as the “Owner Land"; the improvements currently existing thereupon as of the date hereof, the “Owner Building" and, the Owner Land and the Owner Building, together with any future additions, alterations and replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as the"OwnerProperty"); WHEREAS, the Developer is the owner in fee title of those certain parcels of land in Brooklyn, New York, known as and by the street address 1042 President Street, Brooklyn,New York, designated as Block 1280, Lot 29 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, Kings County, and more particularly described in Exhibit A-2 annexed hereto and made a part thereof (said land and tax lots being hereinafter collectively referred to as the “Developer Land"' and, together with any building or improvements placed thereon “Developer Building” hereinafter referred to as, the "Developer Property"; the Owner Land and the Developer Land are herein sometimes jointly referred to as the “Parcels" and each individually as a “Parcel"); and WHEREAS, the Developer intends to construct a new building on the Developer Land (the "Project") that will contain more “floor area" as that term is defined in the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York effective December 15, 1961, as amended to the date hereof (the “Zoning Resolution') than is now available for use under the “floor area ratio" limitation contained in the Zoning Resolution related to Developer Property as an independent zoning lot. NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of the foregoing and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged, the parties hereto agree as follows: ARTICLEI DEFINITIONS 1.
